description: This file defines an interface and classes related to a recursive type used for testing serialization and code generation in Orleans. It includes an interface for a grain with a method that takes and returns a recursive type, as well as the recursive type itself and a generic base class.

classes.name: RecursiveType
classes.description: A serializable class representing a recursive type used in testing for stack overflow issues during code generation.

classes.name: SelfTyped<T>
classes.description: An abstract generic base class that enforces self-referencing typing, used as a base for recursive data types.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: An asynchronous method in the grain interface that takes a RecursiveType argument and returns a Task containing a RecursiveType.
